name: Archetype Test
tagline: Discover which of the 12 classic archetypes drives you.
intro: Stories all over the world are built on a handful of recurring characters: the hero, the sage, the rebel, the caregiver and more. This test shows which of these 12 archetypes shape the way you think, feel and act. Rate 100 short statements on how well they describe you. It takes about five minutes and reveals your leading archetype plus your full profile.
seoTitle: Archetype Test – Find your personality archetype
seoDescription: Which of the 12 archetypes are you? Hero, Sage, Explorer, Creator or Rebel? Take this free 5-minute test and get a personal archetype profile.

innocent.name: The Innocent
innocent.short: Your drive for goodness, trust, simplicity and optimism.
innocent.low: The Innocent plays a small role in your profile. You tend to look at the world with healthy realism or even some scepticism, and you are unlikely to be fooled by empty promises. That protects you, but it can also make it harder to relax and enjoy what is good right now. Try ending each day by naming one thing that went well, and give people a fair chance before deciding they cannot be trusted.
innocent.mid: You carry a balanced dose of the Innocent. You can be hopeful and trusting, yet you also keep your eyes open. This mix lets you enjoy simple pleasures without ignoring real risks. You may notice your optimism fades when you are tired or under pressure. Protect it by keeping some daily routines that feel calm and wholesome, and by spending time with people who bring out your lighter, more hopeful side.
innocent.high: The Innocent is strongly present in you. You believe in goodness, keep faith in a better outcome and bring a refreshing sense of hope to the people around you. Others often feel safe and uplifted in your company. The flip side is that you may overlook warning signs or feel deeply disappointed when people let you down. Keep your optimism, but pair it with a quick reality check before big decisions, and ask a trusted, practical friend for a second opinion.

sage.name: The Sage
sage.short: Your drive to seek truth, understanding and wisdom.
sage.low: The Sage is not a major force in your profile. You are probably more interested in doing, feeling or connecting than in analysing ideas at length. That keeps you practical and quick to act. Still, a little more reflection can prevent avoidable mistakes. Before an important decision, take ten minutes to write down the facts and at least two alternative views. Reading one thoughtful book or article a month can also broaden your perspective without slowing you down.
sage.mid: You have a solid streak of the Sage. You like to understand things and think before you speak, but you do not get lost in theory. This makes you a balanced judge in many situations. To strengthen this side, set aside regular time for learning something that genuinely interests you. At the same time, notice when you are overthinking a choice that simply needs action, and give yourself permission to decide with good-enough information.
sage.high: The Sage is one of your strongest archetypes. You are driven by curiosity and a deep need to understand the truth. People value your calm, objective view and your ability to see beneath the surface. The risk is that you analyse so much that you hesitate to act, or come across as distant. Share your insights in plain language, set deadlines for your research, and remember that some wisdom only comes from trying things out in real life.

explorer.name: The Explorer
explorer.short: Your drive for freedom, discovery and new experiences.
explorer.low: The Explorer is quiet in your profile. You probably value stability, familiar surroundings and the people and places you know well. That gives you roots and makes you reliable. The only risk is that life becomes narrower than you would really like. Try a small adventure now and then: a new route, a new dish or a weekend somewhere you have never been. Small discoveries can refresh you without disturbing the security you value.
explorer.mid: You carry a healthy amount of the Explorer. You enjoy new experiences and value your independence, yet you also appreciate a home base. This balance lets you grow without feeling unsettled. Make sure both sides get space: plan regular moments of discovery, such as trips, courses or new hobbies, while protecting the routines that ground you. When you feel restless, treat it as a signal that it is time to try something new.
explorer.high: The Explorer is a leading force in you. You crave freedom, discovery and authentic experiences, and routine can feel like a cage. Your curiosity makes life rich and inspires others to step outside their comfort zone. The challenge is staying with commitments long enough to see them through. Build variety into your work and relationships so you do not have to leave to feel free, and choose a few long-term goals that are worth the occasional boredom.

outlaw.name: The Rebel
outlaw.short: Your drive to challenge rules, break patterns and spark change.
outlaw.low: The Rebel plays a small part in your profile. You tend to work within existing systems and respect agreed rules, which makes you cooperative and dependable. Others can count on you to keep things running. Sometimes, though, a rule really does need to change. Practise asking one honest question each week: does this way of working still make sense? Speaking up calmly about what is not working can be a constructive form of loyalty.
outlaw.mid: You have a moderate Rebel streak. You follow rules when they make sense but are willing to challenge them when they do not. This makes you a constructive critic who can push for change without burning bridges. Choose your battles: focus your rebellious energy on the issues that really matter to you, and back up your objections with a concrete alternative. That way people experience you as a reformer rather than a troublemaker.
outlaw.high: The Rebel is strongly present in you. You question authority, dislike conformity and are not afraid to disrupt the status quo. This courage can drive real innovation and expose unfairness others accept. The risk is that you reject things simply because they are established, or alienate people who could help you. Channel your energy into a clear cause, look for allies, and remember that building something new often requires as much patience as breaking the old.

magician.name: The Magician
magician.short: Your drive to transform situations and make visions real.
magician.low: The Magician is not prominent in your profile. You probably prefer facts, clear steps and what is proven over grand visions. That keeps you grounded and realistic. Yet some of the best changes start with imagining what does not exist yet. Now and then, ask yourself: what would this look like if it worked perfectly? Writing down a bold vision, even if you only act on a small part of it, can open new possibilities.
magician.mid: You carry a fair amount of the Magician. You can imagine how things might be transformed and you like to see ideas become reality, while keeping your feet on the ground. This makes you a useful bridge between dreamers and doers. Strengthen this side by picking one area of your life you want to change and visualising the end result clearly. Then break it into small, concrete steps so your vision gains momentum.
magician.high: The Magician is one of your strongest archetypes. You believe in transformation and have a gift for turning visions into reality, often in ways that surprise others. You notice hidden connections and can inspire change in people and situations. The risk is promising more than is realistic or using your influence without enough transparency. Share your vision openly, check it against hard facts, and celebrate the small, practical steps that make the magic actually happen.

hero.name: The Hero
hero.short: Your drive to prove yourself through courage and achievement.
hero.low: The Hero is quiet in your profile. You probably feel little need to prove yourself or to compete, which can make you relaxed and pleasant to be around. You do not have to win to feel worthwhile. Still, some challenges are worth fighting for. Pick one goal that genuinely matters to you and commit to it for a set period. Facing a manageable challenge head-on can build confidence you will be glad to have later.
hero.mid: You have a solid share of the Hero. When it really counts, you can find the courage and energy to rise to a challenge, but you do not need constant battles to feel good. This balance protects you from burning out. Keep a few meaningful goals that stretch you, and notice which challenges energise you rather than drain you. Recover properly after big efforts so you have strength left for the next one.
hero.high: The Hero is a leading force in you. You are driven to prove yourself, rise to challenges and stand up for others. Your determination inspires people and helps you achieve what others think is impossible. The danger is that everything becomes a fight, or that you push yourself until you break. Learn to tell which battles truly matter, and allow yourself to accept help. Real strength also includes resting and admitting when something is too much.

lover.name: The Lover
lover.short: Your drive for closeness, passion, beauty and connection.
lover.low: The Lover plays a modest role in your profile. You may keep your emotions private and value independence or practicality over romance and sensual experiences. That can make you steady and level-headed. Still, closeness and beauty feed the soul. Try sharing one personal feeling with someone you trust this week, or take a moment to really enjoy a meal, a song or a view. Small moments of connection can enrich your life considerably.
lover.mid: You carry a balanced amount of the Lover. You value warmth, closeness and beauty, while also keeping a healthy sense of self. This lets you form deep bonds without losing yourself in them. Nurture this side by making regular quality time for the people you love and by surrounding yourself with things you find beautiful. Notice what makes you feel truly alive and give it a regular place in your week.
lover.high: The Lover is one of your strongest archetypes. You live with passion, value deep emotional connection and are highly sensitive to beauty. People feel truly seen in your presence. The risk is losing yourself in relationships or depending too much on others' affection to feel worthwhile. Keep investing in friendships, interests and goals of your own alongside your closest bonds. Being whole on your own makes your love even richer to give.

jester.name: The Jester
jester.short: Your drive for humour, play and living in the moment.
jester.low: The Jester is quiet in your profile. You probably come across as serious, focused and responsible, which earns trust and respect. Yet humour and play are powerful ways to reduce stress and connect with others. Give yourself permission to be light now and then: watch something that makes you laugh, play a game or join in with someone else's fun. You do not need to be the clown to enjoy a lighter side of life.
jester.mid: You have a healthy dose of the Jester. You can enjoy fun and bring humour into a room, but you also know when it is time to be serious. That makes you good company in both easy and difficult moments. Keep this balance by building some play into your routine, especially during busy periods. Notice how humour can defuse tension at work or at home, and use it kindly rather than at someone's expense.
jester.high: The Jester is a leading force in you. You bring laughter, lightness and spontaneity wherever you go, and you help others not to take life too seriously. This is a real gift, especially in tense situations. The risk is using humour to avoid difficult feelings or being taken less seriously than you deserve. Make room for serious conversations too, and show the people close to you that behind the jokes there is real depth.

everyperson.name: The Everyperson
everyperson.short: Your drive to belong, connect as an equal and stay down to earth.
everyperson.low: The Everyperson is not prominent in your profile. You may want to stand out, follow your own path or feel less need to belong to a group. That independence can help you do distinctive things. Just remember that a sense of belonging is also a source of strength and support. Invest in at least one community, team or circle of friends where you can simply be yourself without having to impress anyone.
everyperson.mid: You carry a fair amount of the Everyperson. You value belonging and get along with many types of people, yet you also have your own ambitions. This makes you approachable and adaptable. Keep nurturing the groups where you feel at home, and notice when you are adjusting yourself too much just to fit in. Being part of a group works best when you also bring your own voice into it.
everyperson.high: The Everyperson is one of your strongest archetypes. You are down to earth, loyal and easy to relate to, and you value belonging over standing out. People trust you because you are genuine and treat everyone as an equal. The risk is blending in so much that your own wishes and talents stay hidden. Dare to speak up for what you want, and remember that being ordinary and being remarkable can go hand in hand.

caregiver.name: The Caregiver
caregiver.short: Your drive to protect, support and look after others.
caregiver.low: The Caregiver plays a small role in your profile. You likely expect people to take responsibility for themselves and keep a healthy distance from other people's problems. That protects your energy. At the same time, small acts of care can strengthen your relationships a lot. Try asking someone how they are really doing and listening without solving. You may find that giving a little support also gives you a sense of connection and meaning.
caregiver.mid: You have a balanced Caregiver side. You like to support others and notice when someone needs help, but you also look after your own needs. This lets you care sustainably without burning out. Keep it that way by checking in with yourself regularly: am I giving because I want to or because I feel I must? Accept help from others too, so care flows in both directions in your relationships.
caregiver.high: The Caregiver is a leading force in you. You are compassionate, protective and quick to help, and people feel safe and supported around you. This is a beautiful strength, but it can come at a cost if you constantly put others first. Watch out for exhaustion and resentment. Set clear limits on what you can give, schedule time for your own rest and let others care for you sometimes. You deserve the same kindness you offer.

ruler.name: The Ruler
ruler.short: Your drive to lead, create order and take responsibility.
ruler.low: The Ruler is quiet in your profile. You are probably happy to let others take the lead and feel little need to control how things turn out. That makes you flexible and easy to collaborate with. Still, there may be moments when your input is needed. Practise taking charge of small things, such as organising an outing or chairing a meeting. You may discover you have more leadership ability than you think.
ruler.mid: You carry a solid share of the Ruler. You can take charge and create structure when it is needed, but you are also comfortable following someone else. This makes you a flexible team member and a fair leader. Strengthen this side by taking ownership of a project that matters to you. At the same time, notice when your wish for order makes you less open to other people's ideas.
ruler.high: The Ruler is one of your strongest archetypes. You naturally take responsibility, create order and lead with a long-term view. People often look to you for direction and stability. The risk is becoming controlling or finding it hard to delegate. Remember that strong leaders also empower others. Share decisions where you can, ask for input before you settle on a plan, and allow room for the occasional bit of healthy chaos.

creator.name: The Creator
creator.short: Your drive to imagine, express yourself and make something new.
creator.low: The Creator plays a modest role in your profile. You may prefer clear instructions and proven methods over inventing new things, which makes you efficient and dependable. Creativity, however, is not only for artists. Try a small creative experiment, such as cooking without a recipe, sketching or rearranging a room. You might find that expressing yourself in small ways brings fresh energy and new ideas to your daily life.
creator.mid: You have a fair amount of the Creator. You enjoy making and improving things and sometimes feel a strong need to express yourself, while also valuing practicality. This mix helps you turn ideas into realistic results. Give your creative side a regular outlet, such as a hobby or project with no pressure to be perfect. Keep a notebook for ideas so inspiration does not get lost in busy weeks.
creator.high: The Creator is a leading force in you. You are full of ideas and feel most alive when you are making something original. Your imagination helps you see possibilities others miss. The risk is perfectionism, unfinished projects or frustration when there is no room to create. Choose a few projects to complete rather than starting many, and set realistic deadlines. Protect time for creative work, because for you it is not a luxury but a need.

summary: Everyone carries several archetypes, but usually one or two lead the way. Below you see how strongly each of the 12 archetypes shows up in your answers, with your strongest one highlighted as your main archetype. Use the profile as a mirror for reflection, not as a fixed label.
